messages:
maria.chen: Quick sync — we need to land a thin-slice observability MVP for Console by EoQ. key pieces: dashboards (top routes + model latency), tracing hooks for model spans, cost-per-token breakdown, and an error-rate heatmap.
ashok: +1. Which customer asks are driving this?
devin.k: Acme and BetaCo both flagged lack of per-route cost view and visibility into where latency spikes originate.
sara_g: also wants a simple UX for enabling trace hooks per-model so platform teams can flip on tracing without code changes.
maria.chen: proposed scope for MVP: 1) single dashboard template for top-10 routes (latency, p95/p99, error-rate), 2) cost-summary card (agg cost + cost by model family), 3) lightweight tracing hook that emits model-span metadata (model, seq_len, batch_size), 4) error heatmap by route/time.
kai: tradeoffs: detailed token-level cost requires ingestion/compute that blows retention. suggest aggregated cost buckets (hourly per-route) for MVP.
ashok: agree. keep retention short (7d) for raw events, 90d for aggregates. we can offer extended retention as an add-on.
devin.k: launch criteria suggestions: - dashboard shows p99 within 5s of data, - tracing hook captures model+variant at 99% fidelity, - cost card matches billing within 2%.
sara_g: add: documented runbook for common alerts (latency spike, cost jump, error surge) and an on-call handoff for first 2 weeks after launch.
maria.chen: feature cuts if needed: drop per-request token breakdown and advanced anomaly detection. keep canary with 2 customers (Acme, BetaCo) and one internal app.
kai: implementation note: runtime change needed to attach model-span tags. small patch to router to forward model metadata. I'll own the runtime change.
ashok: dashboard wiring: product will provide template and sample queries. devex to own the code snippets for customers to enable tracing. sara_g to own runbook.
devin.k: QA: we need a lightweight synthetic harness that simulates variable seq_len and batching to validate p95/p99 under load. I can build it.
pm-bot: Reminder: roadmap sync Thurs 10am — please add blockers to the agenda. :bell:
maria.chen: action items: kai -> runtime patch PR by next Wed, devin.k -> synthetic harness by next Fri, sara_g -> draft runbook + alert definitions by next Tue, ashok -> billing verification spec.
ashok: noted. one question: do we expose cost card in Console for Hosted only initially?
maria.chen: yes hosted first, Dedicated will be rollable with same template but disabled until infra cost hooks are available.
kai: Implementation risk: dedicated deployments need a different telemetry sink. we'll add config flag for sink target.
devin.k: ok. final ask: can we keep trace sampling low by default (1%) to control cost and provide a per-customer toggle?
sara_g: +1. sampling toggle UI is low priority but necessary for enterprise customers. add to backlog.
maria.chen: thanks. if nothing else, we'll lock scope after Thurs sync. :rocket:
